verdict.rationale: DBOS has documented, database-backed cron-style scheduled workflows that can be created, paused, resumed, and deleted at runtime, plus queues for managing many workflow runs concurrently, directly satisfying recurring-job scheduling for automation. Community evidence confirms real-world usage with heavy workflow volumes, and the Conductor API/CLI allow scripting/management of schedules. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the cron/scheduling feature (most runtime probes cover CLI/MCP, not the scheduler itself) and more detail on schedule failure/retry semantics.
